name: No Room For Sharks
source:
The story depicts the nightly tribulation of Ana as she rushes through an infinite hall of rooms, encountering those she ran away from four years ago.

[From [url=https://vine-moss-games.itch.io/no-room-for-sharks]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夜裡，安娜在一條彷彿永遠走不到盡頭、兩旁全是房間的走廊上飛奔，遇見了自己四年前曾經逃離的那些人。故事講述的正是她在這夜遭遇的磨難。

［摘自[url=https://vine-moss-games.itch.io/no-room-for-sharks]Itch.io[/url]］
